items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: I remember a guitar clarinet player I'd heard in Phoenix, and a Monk Montgomery who was with the Montgomery Brothers, was in San Francisco, so I hired him.

ctx.x: And I found at the other hotels it was the same way, so when I went in for Maynard, this little room in the Tropicana, we went in for three weeks. And I'd been working on -- oh, around the world with George Wean Williams, so I didn't really know men (unintelligible). Who was around. So I finally -- most the guys I wanted to get were busy or something. items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: He said, 'Well, I've got a job, a three-week engagement in Las Vegas.'

ctx.x: Well, all right, you started to tell me about getting together with Red Norvo.

OK. That broke up. I broke the group up. We made a trip to Vancouver and a trip to so-and-so, but it petered out. I wasn't able to hold the band together.
